description: A scrapbook of India's rising fashion drops: jeans, bottoms, tees, outerwear, shoes, sportswear, anime, polos & regular, and caps & accessories, with the underdog brand behind each trend.
Every TrendXee lane in one place: jeans, bottoms, tees, outerwear, shoes, sportswear, anime, polos & regular, and caps & accessories, each read from live signals.
Baggy denim leads the way, with wide-leg, relaxed, bootcut and flared fits.
